user_saw: Clicking Install on an official plugin card opened the plugin overview, where the user had to click Install again.
summary: Official plugin cards now start installation and show progress in chat, with policy acknowledgments handled on the plugin page.
reasoning: The original card opened an installation review, and its test explicitly verified that the card click sent no install request. PR #150234 deliberately replaced the review with the plugin overview and updated the routing test and docs to require an explicit Install click there. This fix changes that documented flow by making the official card click start installation in chat.
